title: Implement Event Sourcing with CQRS in Python
title_es: Implementar Event Sourcing con CQRS en Python
description: Runnable event-sourced bank account with CQRS separation in Python: event store on PostgreSQL, aggregate root, command handler, durable projections, snapshots and optimistic concurrency.
description_es: Cuenta bancaria event-sourced ejecutable con separación CQRS en Python: event store sobre PostgreSQL, aggregate root, command handler, proyecciones durables, snapshots y concurrencia optimista.
